ParagonScoreCard.explanation: PSN weighs by metal (bronze/silver/gold/platinum) and Xbox by its real Gamerscore — both are official data from each platform. Steam has no per-achievement weight of its own, so here it's estimated by global rarity (rarer means more points): it's an approximation, not verifiable data like the other two.
